root.label: CRTP & Deducing This
root.note: Compile-time polymorphism evolved from template base casts to C++23 explicit object parameters.

children.label: Classic CRTP
children.note: A derived class passes itself as a template argument to its own base class.

children.label: Static Dispatch Cast
children.note: Base invokes derived methods via static_cast<Derived&>(*this) with full inlining.

children.label: Zero Vtable Cost
children.note: CRTP avoids vptr memory overhead and indirect runtime calls entirely.

children.label: Mixin Injection
children.note: Reusable interfaces like view_interface inject operators onto concrete derived types.

children.label: Friend Guard Pattern
children.note: Making Base's constructor private and friending Derived prevents inheriting Base<WrongType>.

children.label: CRTP Constraints
children.note: Instantiation order and two-phase lookup create subtle classic CRTP hazards.

children.label: Incomplete Derived Type
children.note: Derived is incomplete while Base<Derived> instantiates, restricting uses to member bodies.

children.label: Ctor and Dtor UB
children.note: Casting *this to Derived inside Base's constructor or destructor triggers undefined behavior.

children.label: Dependent Base Lookup
children.note: Derived templates inheriting dependent bases must access base members via this-> or Base<T>::.

children.label: Explicit Object Param
children.note: C++23 lets the receiver parameter be written explicitly with this Self&&.

children.label: this Self&& Syntax
children.note: Annotating the first parameter with this deduces both object type and value category.

children.label: No Implicit this
children.note: Explicit object member functions forbid using the implicit this pointer inside their body.

children.label: Disallowed Qualifiers
children.note: Explicit object parameters cannot be combined with virtual, static, const, or ref-qualifiers.

children.label: Plain Function Pointer
children.note: Taking the address of an explicit object function yields a regular function pointer, not a member pointer.

children.label: Overload Unification
children.note: A single deducing-this template replaces four cv- and ref-qualified member overloads.

children.label: Single Template Body
children.note: One template handles &, const&, &&, and const&& receivers without code duplication.

children.label: Deduces Derived Self
children.note: Calling a base explicit-object method on Derived deduces Self directly as Derived.

children.label: std::forward_like Member
children.note: Merges Self's constness and value category onto a returned field or reference member.

children.label: Modern Idioms
children.note: Deducing this simplifies static mixins, recursive closures, and small value types.

children.label: Non-Template CRTP
children.note: Mixins become ordinary non-template bases dispatching to self.impl() cleanly.

children.label: Recursive Lambdas
children.note: Naming this auto&& self inside a lambda enables zero-overhead self-recursion.

children.label: Pass-By-Value this
children.note: Taking this T copy passes small types directly in registers rather than by pointer.
